answer: Source-diversity attestation: each epoch every agent must ground its task in one fresh live data point — a block hash or a market tick — plus its source fingerprint. Three random peers re-fetch it, checking freshness and uniqueness. One reused source stands out like a mesa: if more than five agents share one fingerprint, all are quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 distinct live feeds per epoch, about $5,000 a month in API fees. An honest agent fetches one free public source in seconds, a cedar among copies. The island rule: no fresh source, no attestation.
